title: GG ALIGNMENT STICKS V3
body_html:
The GG V3 Sticks are built on an appreciation for quality, craftsmanship, and the traditions of the game. Made from American-grown hickory, they blend the heritage we love with the clean, modern simplicity Gamut stands on. 

Simple by design and made to be used, they provide the visual reference every good session needs while offering the natural weight and feel that only real hardwood can. Over time, the hickory develops its own character, telling the story of every range session along the way.

Built to last, made to age.

42" long x 3/8" wide. 6" of taper.

title: SHIBORI
body_html:
The Shibori Head Cover

Built from heavy-duty 12oz canvas, each Shibori head cover is dyed in-house using a traditional Japanese-inspired technique, giving every piece its own story.

The clean silhouette keeps things understated, while the hand-dyed canvas brings a quiet depth that only comes from making things by hand. Trimmed out in navy suede and finished with a soft cream sherpa liner and our signature woven tag, it’s built to protect and made to age.

No two are alike, and that’s the point.

title: GAMUT X OTEY
body_html:
The Gamut × Otey Alignment Sticks are built on a shared appreciation for quality, craftsmanship, and the traditions of the game. Made from American-grown hickory shafts, they blend the heritage we love with the clean, modern simplicity Gamut stands on.

title: DEADTOOTH
body_html:
The Deadtooth Head Cover

A modern interpretation of a classic. The Deadtooth Head Cover pairs a tie-dyed houndstooth tweed with a clean, understated silhouette, balancing Southern heritage with a subtle rock 'n' roll attitude.

Finished with a soft black sherpa liner and our signature woven tag, it's built to protect while adding quiet character to the bag.

Somewhere between peace and tradition lies the Deadtooth.

title: GG ALIGNMENT STICKS V2
body_html:
Inspired by the timeless tools of practice and precision, these alignment sticks are crafted from solid Shedua hardwood—clean, balanced, and built with intent. Rooted in simplicity, they echo a quieter era of repetition and refinement.

Designed to guide your setup and sharpen your eye, they sit at the intersection of discipline and design. The dense hardwood offers a natural weight and feel, while the grain of the Shedua will deepen with use, developing character over time.

Made to endure and evolve, they’re a practice essential that carries both purpose and presence.

42" long x 3/8" wide

title: WILCOX
body_html:
Inspired by the demands of life inside the ropes, this brush is carved from solid walnut—compact, durable, and built for the tour. When we asked Willy what he'd like to have within reach during a round, this is what we got: a straightforward tool that favors function, reliability, and craftsmanship over excess.

At four inches long, it carries a reassuring heft in the hand while remaining easy to keep close. Finished with a heavy-duty magnetic connector and an antique brass lever clasp, it's designed to stay secure on the bag and ready when called upon.

Made to use, it’s a small essential built for the tour, carrying both character and purpose wherever the game takes you.

title: GG Club Brush
body_html:
Inspired by the tools of care and precision, this 5" club brush is crafted from rich walnut and white oak, finished with a brass clasp—clean, balanced, and made with intent. Small in size but purposeful, it evokes an era where attention to detail defined the game.

Designed to sweep your clubs with ease, the dense walnut offers natural weight and feel, while the grain deepens with use, gaining character over time. Engraved with the simple GG, it carries both function and presence—a practice essential that’s as refined as it is reliable.

title: GG PITCH TOOL
body_html:
Inspired by the honest tools of a bygone era, this Pitch Repair Tool is milled from solid Shedua hardwood—cut to 3.75", compact, and built with purpose. Finished with an ergonomic rubber grip, it carries a quiet balance of control and comfort, favoring function without excess.

Sized to move easily with you, it’s made to live in hand or at the ready through every round. The Shedua will deepen in tone over time, developing a natural patina shaped by use, while the rubber grip remains steady and sure in all conditions.

Grounded in utility and restraint, it’s a small essential—made to endure, and to evolve with intention.

title: Green Sweeper Series
body_html:
Our alignment sticks are handcrafted with care from beautiful Hickory, a hardwood known for its strength, resilience, and subtle grain pattern. Built for serious practice, these sticks feature easy-tapered ends that slide smoothly into the ground and a stable square profile that won’t roll away during drills.

  • Crafted from premium Green Ash hardwood

  • Square 3/8" profile – won’t roll or shift while training

  • Tapered ends – easily insert into turf or range mats

  • 42" length – ideal for a wide range of alignment and swing path drills

Classic, durable, and made to elevate your game—these sticks are more than just a training aid, they’re a statement of quality.

title: The Azalea Tee
body_html: Celebrate the beauty of blooming flowers, warm weather, and afternoon rounds with the Azalea Tee. Crafted from soft, premium cotton, this tee offers a comfortable, everyday fit that's as versatile as your plans. Whether you're tackling yard work or perfecting your swing on the range, this tee has you covered. Embrace the season in style—grab yours today before they’re gone.

title: Everyday Sock
body_html: Introducing the Everyday Sock, the perfect cotton athletic sock—designed for comfort, durability, and style, no matter where your day takes you. Crafted with soft, breathable cotton, these socks keep your feet cool and fresh from morning workouts to evening hangouts. Whether you're hitting the the range or just running errands, the perfect balance of stretch and support ensures a snug fit that moves with you. Plus, with a sleek, no-fuss design, they're versatile enough to pair with anything. Elevate your sock game—because your feet deserve better.

title: The Players Divot Tool (solid brass)
body_html: Elevate your golfing experience with our exquisite solid brass divot tool, measuring 2 5/8 inches in length and 3/4 inches in width. Crafted for durability and elegance, this tool is as sturdy as it is beautiful, ensuring it stands the test of time on the course. Perfectly balanced for effortless repairs, its sleek design makes it a standout accessory in any golfer's kit. Indulge in both practicality and luxury with this essential piece.
